finding.title: Republish can widen shared links to all estimate sheets

currentRepoProof.head: 668f79cb3f41c5d731f47de22219807974dd3665
sourceControls: src/components/workshop/ProjectPublicationHeader.tsx defaults the sheet picker from summary.selectedEstimateIds for already-published links.
The default selected sheet set is filtered to available estimate ids instead of being widened to every project sheet.
The no-change Update shared page path calls republishProjectPublication with the existing selectedEstimateIds subset.

graphProof.result: ProjectPublicationHeader content shows summarySelectedEstimateIds feeding defaultSelectedEstimateIds for published links and only falling back to all estimate ids when there is no persisted published subset.

dashboardProof.submittedContext: Current main preserves persisted publication sheet scope during republish. getProjectPublicationSummary now returns selectedEstimateIds from selected_estimate_ids, and ProjectPublicationHeader defaults the sheet picker from summary.selectedEstimateIds for published links instead of every project sheet. The no-change Update shared page path therefore calls republishProjectPublication with the existing subset rather than widening to all sheets.
